description: Stores a draft of a listing for 24 hours and returns a pikosabe.com link to it. Nothing is published by this tool: the person opens the link, signs in to Piko with their phone, reviews the prefilled form and publishes it themselves. The draft is checked against the rules of the publishing form (title and description lengths, currency of the market, no phone number in the text). The listing is located at the place confirmed in the person's Piko profile, so the draft carries no city.

country.description: Market to read, as the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country: 243 markets are open, among them PY = Paraguay, BO = Bolivia. Results stay within that market.

description.description: Details in the language of the market, up to 1000 characters, in the person's own terms. Optional.

job.description: Present when the listing is a position an employer wants to fill (a nanny, a shop assistant). It goes with side demand and type service.

pay_period.description: Period the pay in price_amount is quoted for. Omitted: month.

price_amount.description: Price for an offer, pay for a position, maximum budget for another demand. Omitted when the person gave no amount.

price_currency.description: Currency code of the amount: the local currency of the market or USD. Omitted: the market's own currency.

side.description: offer: the person offers a service or has something to sell or rent out. demand: the person is looking for a service, a thing or someone to hire.

title.description: Listing title in the language of the market, 10 to 60 characters, for example "Electricista matriculado a domicilio".

transaction.description: Goods offered: sale, free or exchange. Property offered or wanted: sale or rental. Pets offered or wanted: sale or free (adoption). Other types have no transaction.

type.description: Listing type. rental is a thing rented out by the day or week; housing for sale or rent is property.
